about: Sealing to an organisation's key (F-316), across languages: crates/orgkeys seal_for_org and open_for_org, and the dashboard's docs/landing/org/orgseal.js on the vendored hpke-js. Both test suites read this file. The organisation key is RFC 9180 DeriveKeyPair(org_ikm); info is "krate org seal v1\u0000" + context; the associated data is org_public; sealed is base64 of enc || ciphertext. Each case's ephemeral key is DeriveKeyPair(ikm_e), so both sides must make exactly `sealed` and open it. page_random was sealed by the page with a random ephemeral key and must open in Rust; rust_random was sealed by crates/orgkeys the same way and must open in the page.
suite: RFC 9180 base mode, DHKEM(X25519, HKDF-SHA256), HKDF-SHA256, ChaCha20-Poly1305
